name: twibbonzr
description: Twibbonzr — buat, bagikan, dan pasang twibbon. Batas global 50 twibbon per 14 hari, foto pengguna hanya disimpan di localStorage.

scripts.setup: prisma generate && prisma db push && node scripts/generate-templates.js && node prisma/seed.js
scripts.build: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && node prisma/seed.js
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && node prisma/seed.js
scripts.db:reset: prisma generate && prisma db push --force-reset && node scripts/generate-templates.js && node prisma/seed.js
